hair_follicle_placode_specimen.species: Mus musculus (Embryonic E12.5-E13.5 whole-mount in situ hybridization showing quasi-hexagonal vibrissa/hair follicle placode rows and epidermal cross-sections)
hair_follicle_placode_specimen.author: Dennis M. Maddox and Brian G. Condie (BMC Developmental Biology 4:4, 2004)

governing_equations.section: Sick et al. (2006) Science 314:1447-1450 & Supporting Online Material (Meinhardt-Gierer WNT/DKK Saturating Activator-Inhibitor PDE)
governing_equations.wnt_activator_pde: dw/dt = rho_w + c_w * w^2 / (h * (1 + kappa * w^2)) - mu_w * w + D_w * Lap(w)
governing_equations.dkk_inhibitor_pde: dh/dt = rho_h + c_h * w^2 - mu_h * h + D_h * Lap(h)
governing_equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic or zero-flux Neumann boundary conditions on embryonic epidermal sheet Omega

linear_stability_invariants.homogeneous_stability_condition: mu_h > mu_w (DKK inhibitor turns over faster than WNT activator so tr(J_0) < 0 and det(J_0) > 0)
linear_stability_invariants.interfollicular_insertion_law: When epidermal domain expands from L to 2*L, existing primary follicles at x = 0 and x = 2*L leave an uninhibited midpoint at x = L where DKK decays below the autocatalytic threshold, triggering secondary wave placode insertion.

wild_type_primary_wave.description: Wild-type E14.5 primary hair follicle placode wave (N=42x42 periodic, rho_w = 0.001, rho_h = 0.0, kappa = 0.02, D_w = 0.015, D_h = 0.45): regular array of 15 WNT-high placodes (periodic local maxima; 14 seam-aware threshold components, one of which is a touching pair) surrounded by DKK1/DKK2 lateral inhibition halos, compared with the 16 segmented placodes in Panel B of the Mus musculus specimen. Pass 3 correction: the Pass 2 value 16 counted ndi.label components without the periodic seam (2 seam duplicates).

secondary_wave_interfollicular_insertion.description: Sick et al. (2006) Figs. 3-4: 2x epidermal expansion between E14.5 (N=40) and E16.5 (N=80) reduces DKK concentration midway between the 4 primary follicles, triggering de novo insertion of 4 secondary hair follicle placodes in the inter-follicular spaces (total 8 placodes, exact 2.0x doubling).

k14_wnt_overexpression.description: Sick et al. (2006) Fig. 2B-D: Transgenic epidermal WNT overexpression (elevated rho_w = 0.004, D_w = 0.008, D_h = 0.32, kappa = 0.015) increases follicular density from 15 to 30 closely spaced clustered placodes (2.0x; qualitative benchmark - Sick et al. report increased density, not a ratio). Pass 3 correction of the Pass 2 values 16 -> 22/32.

enlarged_ringing_follicles_saturated.description: Sick et al. (2006) Fig. 3-4: High autocatalytic saturation (kappa = 0.025, D_w = 0.025, D_h = 0.65) shifts small spots to enlarged plateau/ring-like follicular domains (mean seam-aware component area increases from 26.9 px^2 to 37.2 px^2, +38.5%, while count drops to 10). Pass 3 correction of the Pass 2 values 21.4/31.0/12.

dkk1_transgenic_blockade.description: Andl et al. (2002) Dev. Cell 2:643-653 & Sick et al. (2006) Fig. 4: High ectopic Dkk1 expression (rho_h = 0.12) floods the epidermis with long-range inhibitor, clamping WNT below the autocatalytic threshold and abolishing all placode initiation (0 placodes).

equal_diffusion_negative_control.description: Equal-diffusion ablation control (D_w = D_h = 0.015, d = 1.0 < d_c = 5.8284): perturbations decay exponentially to the spatially uniform epidermal state with 0 placodes.

dermal_condensate_model.description: Reduced-order 3D coupling of the WT 2D epidermal WNT placode field (planar FGF20 source at z = 0) to a 42 x 42 x 12 dermal slab (lateral periodic, zero-flux in depth) in which mesenchymal density rho follows Keller-Segel (1970) chemotaxis with volume filling (Painter & Hillen 2002), attracted by placode FGF20 (Huh et al. 2013; Glover et al. 2017) and repelled by dermally produced BMP4 (Botchkarev et al. 1999; Mou et al. 2006). Hair peg downgrowth is a per-placode scalar depth ODE slaved to the dermal condensate beneath the placode; stage labels follow the ordinal Paus et al. (1999) scheme as a model convention (stage 1 placode, 2 hair germ, 3 early peg, 4 hair peg). The epidermis remains planar (no deforming epithelial interface).

equations.fgf20: df/dt = D_f Lap3(f) - mu_f f + s_f * S(x,y) delta_{z=0},  S = clip((w - w_thr)/(w_max - w_thr), 0, 1)
equations.bmp4: db/dt = D_b Lap3(b) - mu_b b + s_b * rho
equations.mesenchyme: drho/dt = D_rho Lap3(rho) - chi_f div(m grad f) + chi_b div(m grad b),  m = rho (1 - rho/rho_max)
equations.hair_peg: dz_i/dt = v_peg clip((e_i - e_thr)/(rho_max - e_thr), 0, 1),  e_i = mean upper-dermal rho in the 3x3 column beneath placode i
equations.instructed_stability: Epidermis-free dermal subsystem: -tr M(q) = (D_rho + D_b) q + mu_b > 0, det M(q) = D_rho q (D_b q + mu_b) + chi_b m_0 s_b q >= 0 for all q >= 0 (Lean 4 dermal_subsystem_instructed_stable)
equations.keller_segel_comparison: Autonomous Keller-Segel determinant det_KS(q) = D_rho q (D_f q + mu_f) - chi_f m_0 s_f q < 0 iff chi_f m_0 s_f > D_rho (D_f q + mu_f) (Lean 4 keller_segel_fourier_det_sign)
